baseline.e2h_protocol.value: greedy, EOS suppressed, exactly 512 new tokens on a C-token prompt; TTFT from a max_new_tokens=1 call and decode seconds by subtraction; prompts distinct per batch element; prefix caching off

overhead.8b.c4096.e11.commit.note: vllm unproved 1592.345 / proved 30.306 (tok_s.seq5.c4096.commit, 33 chunks (head included)). ASSUMPTION: REGIME 1, the same convention stream E7 used in notes/sufficiency.md: every proved position is charged one measured C=4096 decoded token, so the proved rate in positions/second equals the frozen tok/s row unchanged. This is CONSERVATIVE for E11 -- a prompt position inside a causal rectangle attends to ~N/2 keys, not a full C band -- and it is an assumption, not a measurement: no E11 proved row exists. The unproved side needs no assumption; it is measured directly as (prompt + output) / wall of the concatenated pass.
